name: zclass_camera_sync_view_context_positions
description: zClass_Camera::SyncViewContextPositions mirrors the active camera position into horizon helper nodes and preserves the horizon-XZ node's Y position.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this camera helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass camera/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x44d320 validates the active view-context load, full camera position copy into horizonNode, horizonXZNode position read to preserve Y, X/Z copy from cameraPos, updatedAnyNode gating, and gwNodeUpdateAll call only after a node update.
The native smoke verifies full horizon-node position sync and horizon-XZ position sync with the original Y coordinate preserved.
